facts.value: The Computer Center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: The telephone hotline of Goethe University, the student registry, and the Central Study Counseling help with questions regarding applications, semester dates, re-registration, changing subjects, dual studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: International Student Services provide international students with information on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, studying successfully, careers, and more. They also offer consultation and support.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: The Student Services support students in social and economic matters. Their mission is to ensure that students at the universities have the necessary infrastructure to successfully study in areas such as educational support, student housing, cafeteria services, and advisory and care facilities.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance
